title: Checkpoint: the middle pair
prompt:
Return the **middle two characters** of any string of length ≥ 2 — for even length the two straddling the center, for odd length the center character plus the one after it. (Shorter strings: return them unchanged.) Implement `process(String s)`.

Examples: `"code"` → `"od"`, `"abcde"` → `"cd"`, `"ab"` → `"ab"`.

tests.name: middle pair
tests.hint: One formula: start = (length - 1) / 2; take two characters from there.
